frontend_provenance: Pinned actual MatIEC iec2c parses source and produces POUS.h/POUS.c; generated C compiled unmodified; no handwritten ST expression IR
interface: void MAIN(void); only external G_RBESS_PCMD REAL32; GVT allocation and full app packaging are independent
memory_adapter: Per invocation stack-only pointer/flags initialization; no write of external initial value; REAL accessor adapter uses volatile accesses; global force explicitly unsupported

host_semantics.method: Same generated POUS.c and wrapper.c compiled by real GCC for Linux/x86 and executed
host_semantics.scope: Actual generated C behavior on x86 only; no proof ARM execution/vendor arithmetic equivalence

coverage: Source rule change changes ARM object
Reject helper/local state/WHILE before ARM compile
Clang -MD includes actual compiler system resource headers
Reject dependency not snapshotted before compile
verification.skipped_scope: 5 existing llc tests require their opt-in executable environment; all16 new MatIEC tests executed

toolchain_gap: clang20 and resource headers installed by root from Ubuntu; actual -MD observed Clang built-in standard headers and pinned MatIEC headers, no ARM libc/sysroot in these builds. Unsupported helper/libc references are rejected. This does not make arbitrary IEC libraries freestanding.
limitations: Only fixed existing external REAL; no arbitrary IEC program/variable allocator
No local persistent state, FB, timer, forcing, physical I/O or standalone scheduler
MatIEC uses actual C REAL f32 semantics; not promised byte-equivalent to vendor widening/helper arithmetic
No new compiler path hardware deployment/ABI acceptance
Bound objects and full model/version-specific application closure remain separate
MatIEC headers contain unused variadic helpers with Clang warnings; profile rejects generated helper calls and output requires only expected external symbol
